## Trigger

When I author a catalog skill, I want to read from the invocation value where its description comes from, so I can choose the value without the architecture document.

## Context

Since basicly-tvu17lj every skill root advertises an invocation: user skill with its first body paragraph, and cli-tools routes the model to it. The value user still says that only a human reaches it. The axis now means: description field (model) or first body paragraph (user). A rename breaks every consumer source in .basicly-local that declares invocation: user, so it needs a migration path in lint (accept the old value with a warning and the new name, for one release).
